# Generated by tools/build_transformations.py.

# Learn the form in var:ac_tf_training (or $FORM$ via ac_learn_tf_effect).
ac_learn_tf_limitbreaker_effect = {
	add_trait = ac_tf_limitbreaker
	add_prestige = 250
	ac_add_core_progress_effect = { CORE = power PROGRESS = 25 }
}
ac_learn_tf_reaper_effect = {
	add_trait = ac_tf_reaper
	add_prestige = 250
	ac_add_core_progress_effect = { CORE = power PROGRESS = 25 }
}
ac_learn_tf_godhand_effect = {
	add_trait = ac_tf_godhand
	add_prestige = 250
	ac_add_core_progress_effect = { CORE = power PROGRESS = 25 }
}
ac_learn_tf_soul_domain_effect = {
	add_trait = ac_tf_soul_domain
	add_prestige = 250
	ac_add_core_progress_effect = { CORE = power PROGRESS = 25 }
}
ac_learn_tf_malocchio_effect = {
	add_trait = ac_tf_malocchio
	add_prestige = 250
	ac_add_core_progress_effect = { CORE = power PROGRESS = 25 }
}
ac_learn_tf_titan_effect = {
	add_trait = ac_tf_titan
	add_prestige = 250
	ac_add_core_progress_effect = { CORE = power PROGRESS = 25 }
}
ac_learn_tf_asura_effect = {
	add_trait = ac_tf_asura
	add_prestige = 250
	ac_add_core_progress_effect = { CORE = power PROGRESS = 25 }
}
ac_learn_trained_tf_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:ac_tf_training ?= flag:limitbreaker } ac_learn_tf_limitbreaker_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_tf_training ?= flag:reaper } ac_learn_tf_reaper_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_tf_training ?= flag:godhand } ac_learn_tf_godhand_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_tf_training ?= flag:soul_domain } ac_learn_tf_soul_domain_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_tf_training ?= flag:malocchio } ac_learn_tf_malocchio_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_tf_training ?= flag:titan } ac_learn_tf_titan_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_tf_training ?= flag:asura } ac_learn_tf_asura_effect = yes }
	remove_variable = ac_tf_training
}

# Owner scope: begin training $FORM$ toward scope:ac_tf_master (yourself when alone).
ac_begin_tf_training_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = ac_tf_training value = flag:$FORM$ }
	start_scheme = { type = ac_train_transformation target_character = scope:ac_tf_master }
}

# Fighter scope, in a Clash of Auras: transform into $FORM$.
ac_duel_transform_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = ac_duel_tf value = flag:$FORM$ }
	ac_spend_chi_effect = { CHI = 1 }
	if = { limit = { ac_tf_chi_bonus > 0 has_variable = ac_chi_spent } change_variable = { name = ac_chi_spent subtract = ac_tf_chi_bonus } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_chi_spent var:ac_chi_spent < 0 } set_variable = { name = ac_chi_spent value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = ac_duel_vitality add = ac_tf_vitality_bonus }
	# Godhand: heal to full upon transforming.
	if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_tf = flag:godhand var:ac_duel_vitality < { value = ac_duel_max_vitality add = ac_tf_vitality_bonus } }
		set_variable = { name = ac_duel_vitality value = { value = ac_duel_max_vitality add = ac_tf_vitality_bonus } } }
}

# Fighter scope: the AI transforms into the first form it knows.
ac_duel_ai_transform_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_tf_reaper } ac_duel_transform_effect = { FORM = reaper } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_tf_godhand } ac_duel_transform_effect = { FORM = godhand } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_tf_soul_domain } ac_duel_transform_effect = { FORM = soul_domain } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_tf_malocchio } ac_duel_transform_effect = { FORM = malocchio } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_tf_titan } ac_duel_transform_effect = { FORM = titan } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_tf_asura } ac_duel_transform_effect = { FORM = asura } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_tf_limitbreaker } ac_duel_transform_effect = { FORM = limitbreaker } }
}

# Winner scope, scope:ac_duel_loser: Malocchio copies one of the foe's attack Techniques.
ac_duel_malocchio_copy_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_tf ?= flag:malocchio ac_known_technique_count < ac_max_known_techniques }
		if = { limit = { scope:ac_duel_loser = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_cleave } NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_cleave } } add_character_flag = ac_tech_cleave custom_tooltip = ac_tf_malocchio_copied_tt }
		else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_duel_loser = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_wrathful_fist } NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_wrathful_fist } } add_character_flag = ac_tech_wrathful_fist custom_tooltip = ac_tf_malocchio_copied_tt }

# AI cultivators who could learn a form train it alone, or under a master at court.
ac_ai_transformation_routine_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes ac_can_learn_any_transformation_trigger = yes NOT = { any_scheme = { type = ac_train_transformation } } }
		save_scope_as = ac_tf_master
		if = { limit = { ac_can_learn_tf_reaper_trigger = yes } ac_begin_tf_training_effect = { FORM = reaper } }
		else_if = { limit = { ac_can_learn_tf_godhand_trigger = yes } ac_begin_tf_training_effect = { FORM = godhand } }
		else_if = { limit = { ac_can_learn_tf_soul_domain_trigger = yes } ac_begin_tf_training_effect = { FORM = soul_domain } }
		else_if = { limit = { ac_can_learn_tf_malocchio_trigger = yes } ac_begin_tf_training_effect = { FORM = malocchio } }
		else_if = { limit = { ac_can_learn_tf_titan_trigger = yes } ac_begin_tf_training_effect = { FORM = titan } }
		else_if = { limit = { ac_can_learn_tf_asura_trigger = yes } ac_begin_tf_training_effect = { FORM = asura } }
		else_if = { limit = { ac_can_learn_tf_limitbreaker_trigger = yes } ac_begin_tf_training_effect = { FORM = limitbreaker } }
	}
}
